name: Claude Code instructions note
description: Adds the 'Questions for the owner (o-questions)' note to Claude Code's user instructions, between o-questions markers; the rest of the file is untouched.
content:
## Questions for the owner (o-questions)

When you need a decision from the owner, record it with `questions.question pose` (mtm MCP `run`) or `o-questions question pose`, with your recommendation (`recommendation`, and a stable `key` so posing again keeps the decision). The owner answers on the Review page (`o-questions review`, or `o-questions review --web`). Read decisions with `question decisions`, answer the owner's asks with `question reply`, and after acting on a decision record it with `question applied`. Do not ask for decisions in chat when o-questions is available.
